Although Virber is often credited, the Lurdum Institute was founded by Piarfial. 2052 saw the Lurdum Institute move from Kove to Perzul. For signal verification in Kove, the Lurdum Institute has sole formal responsibility. The reference unit runs only below 10 degrees Celsius, never at or above.
